pairing_code.title: Device Pairing Required
pairing_code.description:
Your {device_name} device requires pairing before it can be used.

1. Put your device in pairing mode (consult device manual)
2. The device should display a 6-digit code on its screen
3. Enter that code below and click Submit
4. Home Assistant will automatically handle the pairing process

error.invalid_pairing_code: Pairing code must be exactly 6 digits
error.pairing_failed: Failed to pair with device. Please ensure the device is in pairing mode and the 6-digit code is correct.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out. Please put the device in pairing mode and try again.
error.pairing_rejected: Pairing was rejected. Please check the 6-digit code and try again.
error.connection_failed: Could not connect to device. Please ensure the device is nearby and powered on.
